about: Which IP literals a download may never reach (private, local, link-local, reserved, multicast, and IPv6 forms that carry such an IPv4 address). Copies that must agree: src-tauri/src/network.rs is_blocked_address (the desktop app; private_host_contract test) and sdk/api/shared/blockedAddress.ts isBlockedIpLiteral (the webview download paths through webFetchGuard.ts, and the SDK fake ctx.net; src/tests/privateHostContract.test.ts, src/tests/huntMFakeNetTwin.test.ts). Hosts are written as a URL's hostname gives them (IPv6 in brackets, compressed, lower case). The TypeScript copy is sdk/api/shared/blockedAddress.ts, shared by the webview guard and the SDK's fake ctx.net (toimprove 268, 274).
